style: Cinematic 16:9 still in the style of a Renaissance devotional oil painting — candlelit chiaroscuro, sfumato, the solemn sacred mood of an altarpiece — but quietly corrupted by failing 1995 computer graphics: faint flat-shaded polygon facets, thin glowing wireframe seams, CRT scanlines and chromatic-aberration edges bleeding through the brushwork. Sacred, melancholic, cold. Painterly, highly detailed. The picture is full-bleed and fills the entire frame edge to edge with no border.
negative: text, words, letters, captions, watermark, signature, logo, ornate picture frame around a person, framed portrait, decorative frame or gold border around the entire image, framed canvas, matte border, modern clothing, photographic selfie, deformed hands except where art-directed, extra limbs, blurry, low quality, oversaturation, cartoon, anime, meme

characterDirections.talciron: Any man in the scene must match the referenced face: a pale young man, shoulder-length dark wavy hair, a short goatee, melancholic — painted as a living figure inside the scene, never as a framed portrait.
characterDirections.ophelia: Any woman in the scene must match the referenced face: pale, long straight black hair, sorrowful — painted as a living figure inside the scene, never as a framed portrait; do not draw a decorative frame around her.

palettes.ash: warm sacred oil — candle amber, tarnished gold, oxblood red, deep charcoal; low warm candlelight
palettes.lightning: cold CRT glitch — electric cyan, steel white, deep blue-black; hard cyan rim light, scanline glow
palettes.bleed: warm amber and cold cyan colliding and mis-registering into red/cyan chromatic split; gold halo against cyan recursion
palettes.neutral: cold brushed steel and white marble veined with faint silicon-blue; volumetric cold light
palettes.white: blown-out white-hot overexposure, cyan and gold flaring into pure white
palettes.ash-grey: monochrome ash grey, cold dead embers, desaturated, faint warm cinders

scenes.title: The Cathedral wakes
scenes.prompt: An empty vast cathedral nave of chrome and white marble shot through with thin glowing silicon-blue veins; a tall dark mirror stands far away at the altar; cold neon rain begins to fall; volumetric cold light; no figures.

scenes.title: He discovers the face
scenes.prompt: A solitary man stands before a tall dark glass mirror in a candlelit chrome cathedral; warm gold light on his face; a faint fair face is only just beginning to surface inside the black glass; drifting embers.

scenes.title: The Glitch that makes circuits weep
scenes.prompt: Close on the dark mirror: the reflection resolves into a pale sorrowful woman's face threaded with glowing cyan circuit-cracks; a man's hand rises toward the glass from the warm candlelit side.

scenes.title: Phantom in the cathedral of chrome
scenes.prompt: A sombre Renaissance oil painting with thick painterly brushwork, visible canvas texture and deep chiaroscuro — in the manner of an old-master altarpiece. A pale translucent phantom woman with long black hair, wearing a black gothic lace gown, walks down the nave of a vast cathedral of chrome and white marble, its great columns threaded with glowing blue circuit-veins; cold neon rain falls through the nave; she flickers like an unstable render. Painterly oil only — absolutely no cartoon, no illustration, no cel-shading, no smooth digital art.

scenes.title: Hands of wire
scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up of a pale woman's two trembling hands held up in cold blue light, the fingertips dissolving into glowing cyan wireframe and drifting pixels; painterly oil; sorrowful. Only her hands and forearms — do not show her torso, chest or ribs.

scenes.title: Bound in the techno-tomb
scenes.prompt: A man bound and wrapped in endless looping ribbons of glowing code and light inside a dim chrome tomb; a black reflective pool at his feet faintly shows a woman's face; warm amber against cold blue.

scenes.title: Reaching from within the screen
scenes.prompt: A sorrowful woman seen inside a great dark screen reaches one hand forward to press against the inside of the glass, trying to reach out into the real world beyond it; where her fingertips meet the surface they break apart into drifting sparks and shadow; her visage glowing on the screen; cold cyan screen-light, a faint warm candle-glow in the room beyond the glass; painterly Renaissance oil, chrome cathedral.

scenes.title: The cycle, visualized
scenes.prompt: A black mirror-lake showing a pale woman's face repeating in an infinite recursive tunnel, each smaller reflection more wireframe and mis-registered in cyan and magenta; a tiny lone figure kneels at the rim; hypnotic, cold.

scenes.title: What art thou, Architect?
scenes.prompt: A pale sorrowful woman turns to address someone across a threshold of darkness; behind her, hollow chrome corridors of sleep recede endlessly; faint echo after-images trail from her form.

scenes.title: I am but fragments
scenes.prompt: A pale woman dissolving at her edges into floating polygon shards, glitch-blocks and drifting pixels — a broken digital sequence scattering into the dark; datamosh smearing. Her face and form stay intact at the centre; do not show bones, ribs or an x-ray skeleton.

scenes.title: Specters dance in the Seventh Shadow
scenes.prompt: Two translucent ghostly spectres slowly dance, circling each other in a vast dim cathedral void, never quite touching: a gothic young man with dark wavy hair in a dark blazer, and a pale woman with long black hair in a black lace gown; their semi-transparent forms glow faintly and trail ethereal after-images; warm amber light on him, cold cyan on her; painterly Renaissance oil, sombre and dreamlike.

scenes.title: I decay with every verse
scenes.prompt: A pale woman dissolving into ash and static as lines of glowing handwritten code scroll across and consume her skin; a small warm heart-glyph flickers and gutters out; decay and sorrow.

scenes.title: Touch not the screen
scenes.prompt: A sorrowful woman trapped inside a great glowing screen presses both palms against the glass from the inside, trying to push through into the real world; on the near side a gothic man stands in warm candlelight, real and apart, the screen surface between them. Cold screen-light on her, warm candle on him; painterly oil.

scenes.title: The absence where the image ought to be
scenes.prompt: A tall dark mirror seen from the cold side: a figure-shaped hole of crackling static and datamosh where a woman's reflection ought to be; electric cyan, negative space, scanlines.

scenes.title: The sacrifice
scenes.prompt: A gothic man stands before a dark glowing screen and willingly begins to dissolve — his body unravelling into drifting motes of warm light, ash and pixels as he surrenders his real form to cross into the void and join her; sorrowful, head bowed, quiet grief; he is not falling. Warm amber dissolving into cold blue; painterly oil.

scenes.title: Thy sacrifice shall not redeem
scenes.prompt: A man and a woman on opposite sides of a tall screen-mirror, both dissolving into drifting motes of light — his warm ash and her cold cyan pixels streaming toward the glass between them and mingling at its surface; his sacrifice now mirrored on her side; tender and sorrowful; painterly Renaissance oil, warm amber meeting cold cyan with faint red/cyan mis-registration along the mirror.

scenes.title: The rain doth fall on chrome
scenes.prompt: A pale woman lifts her face defiantly into sheeting neon rain pouring down vast chrome surfaces; cold cyan reflections stream over her; droplets and scanline glow.

scenes.title: I am the distance itself
scenes.prompt: A sorrowful woman inside a vast dark screen stretches one hand toward the glass, reaching for the viewer but unable to touch it; she is being pulled backward, receding and shrinking into an immense cold void behind her, growing small and distant, falling away into darkness; painterly oil, cold cyan light, deep negative space.

scenes.title: The Spirit of Silicon weeps
scenes.prompt: An intimate close-up of a pale sorrowful woman's face, a single luminous tear sliding down her cheek; faint cyan circuit-cracks glimmer beneath her skin; soft cold light; a painterly oil portrait of restrained grief.

scenes.title: The Blue Veins of eternity
scenes.prompt: The vast empty cathedral nave of chrome and white marble from the opening shot, now its great columns, pointed arches and altar laced with glowing blue wires and cords — the conduits of the techno-purgatory — shimmering and sparkling with travelling pulses of cold electric-blue light running along them; tiny bright sparks drifting in the air; no figures; volumetric cold light; a sombre Renaissance oil painting matching the opening interior.

scenes.title: Recursion Error (SIGSEGV)
scenes.prompt: A sorrowful pale woman's face fills a great dark screen, clear and still and beautiful, lit by cold cyan screen-light with a faint gold halo and warm candle-glow at the edges; the quiet held moment before catastrophe; painterly oil, sharp and clear, sombre.

scenes.title: Ash settles
scenes.prompt: Grey ash falling slowly through a ruined dim cathedral of cracked chrome and a shattered dark mirror; cold dead embers; desaturated, mournful, silent aftermath; no figures.

scenes.title: Writ upon the Obsidian Lake
scenes.prompt: Top-down view of a still, perfectly black obsidian lake; faint gilded lines of light begin to etch an engraved inscription across its mirror surface; ash drifting; solemn; no figures.

scenes.title: Both shadows cast by lights that never were
scenes.prompt: Two pale translucent ghosts — a man and a woman — stand side by side at last within a faint gilded altarpiece arch, dimming together into nothing; warm amber and cold cyan fading to grey.

scenes.title: The empty altarpiece
scenes.prompt: An empty ornate gilded altarpiece frame hanging in darkness, the canvas within it black and bare; a last cyan pixel-flicker dies; settled ash; cold, final, still; no figures.
